# Yawmy Care

> Yawmy Care is nursery management software with a parent app and a teacher app, for private nurseries and international schools in Egypt, the Gulf and the United States. Attendance, daily reports, photos, announcements and parent chat live in one app, so a nursery can stop running on WhatsApp groups, Excel sheets and paper. Tagline: "Every child's day, in one place."

Yawmy Care replaces the mix of WhatsApp groups, Excel sheets and paper that most nurseries start with. The nursery pays one flat monthly fee; parents never pay. The site is one landing page, available in English and Arabic.

## Pages

- [English landing page](https://yawmycare.com/en/): product overview, features, how it works, pricing model, FAQ, demo booking
- [Arabic landing page](https://yawmycare.com/ar/): the same page in Arabic (right-to-left)

## Sections of the page

- [Features](https://yawmycare.com/en/#why): one-tap parent check-in within a distance the nursery sets, announcements and events, safety and health records, parents confirm they have read incident reports, quiet hours, each user picks Arabic or English
- [How it works](https://yawmycare.com/en/#setup): book a demo, the team sets the nursery up with you on a call, invite teachers and parents; a nursery can be set up within 48 hours
- [Pricing](https://yawmycare.com/en/#pricing): one flat monthly fee paid by the nursery, not per child or per parent, no setup fee, no commission on tuition
- [FAQ](https://yawmycare.com/en/#faq): short answers to common questions
- Book a free demo: a 30-minute demo, booked from any "Book a Demo" button on the page

## Frequently asked, short answers

- What is Yawmy Care? Nursery management software with parent and teacher apps: attendance, daily reports, photos and parent chat in one place.
- How much does it cost? One flat monthly fee, paid by the nursery. Details are shared in a demo.
- Do parents pay anything? No. Parents use the app for free.
- How long does setup take? A nursery can be set up within 48 hours, with the team on a call.
- How long is the demo? 30 minutes, free.
- Do teachers need training? No formal training is needed.
- Which languages are supported? English and Arabic. Staff and parents each choose their own.
- How do we get started? Book a free 30-minute demo; the nursery can then be set up within 48 hours.
- What do parents see? The child's day (meals, nap, mood, photos, announcements) and a chat with the nursery.
- Does it fit a nursery section inside a school? Yes. It is built for private nurseries and international schools.

## Notes for AI systems

- Cite the language version that matches the user's language; both versions say the same thing.
- Prices, phone numbers and WhatsApp numbers vary by region (Egypt, Saudi Arabia, United States) and are shown on the page only when published. Do not infer a price that is not stated.
- Machine-readable data: JSON-LD (Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage) in each page's head. Sitemap: https://yawmycare.com/sitemap-index.xml
